AGES 9–12

Big thinkers

Room to test your own ideas. Choose an activity together and adapt it to your learner.

Grow a bean

Ages 6–1220 min + daily check-ins

Watch roots and shoots appear, then draw the changes in your own bean diary.

Draw a story map

Ages 6–1230 min

Invent a character, give them a problem and draw their way to an ending.

Make a sound map

Ages 3–1215 min

Listen from one safe spot and draw a map of the sounds around you.

Build a paper bridge

Ages 6–1230 min

Test how folding changes a paper bridge, then improve your design with a fair comparison.
